integrity: General proof is elementary and symbolic; finite construction tests are corroboration only. No independent validation or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite deterministic local outcome ranges; all individual-agent exact outcome-set families must be partitions, with every block tuple intersecting.
For three or more agents the optimized cost is a uniform per-block maximum, not a complete heterogeneous vector.
Potential older equivalent formulations in finite game forms and combinatorial array theory have not been completely ruled out.
title: Exact minimal action budgets for partition-valued effectivity functions
